description: This file defines the VerticalXAxisRenderer class, a specialized renderer for the X axis in bar chart visualizations within the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for initializing, formatting, and drawing the vertical X axis, including tick marks, labels, and axis titles.

classes.name: VerticalXAxisRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing and managing the vertical X axis in 2D bar charts, handling axis calculations, layout, and rendering.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer info based on the chart's X axis, setting up axis properties and labels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space required for axis title and tick labels, preparing layout dimensions.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the tick labels, tick marks, axis line, and axis title on the graphics context.

methods.name: CalculateXAxisValues
methods.description: Determines scale, tick intervals, and tick mark widths based on chart data.

methods.name: InitXValues
methods.description: Initializes the X values for the axis, either from user data or default numeric sequence.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Calculates start and end positions for major and minor tick marks based on axis configuration.
